premise: A jilted bride marries a scarred stranger to escape ruin, only to discover he is the missing Duke of Ashburton, and together they reclaim his title from the usurpers who poisoned his mother and framed her for witchcraft.
title_promise: The title promises a romance where a woman marries a broken soldier who turns out to be a duke, delivering a Cinderella-meets-identity-reveal fantasy.

characters.name: Juliana Ashcroft
characters.role_for_strangers: the jilted bride who becomes a healer and duchess
characters.description: A resilient noblewoman cast out by her family, who uses her herbal knowledge to heal others and wins the love of a hidden duke.

characters.name: Alexander Ashburton
characters.role_for_strangers: the scarred soldier who is secretly the Duke of Ashburton
characters.description: A war veteran presumed dead, living in exile until he reclaims his title and saves his wife from execution.

characters.name: Clarissa Ashcroft
characters.role_for_strangers: Juliana's sister who steals her fiancé
relationships: daughter of Lord and Lady Ashcroft
characters.description: Ambitious and cruel, she marries Juliana's former fiancé and gloats over her sister's downfall.

characters.name: Gerald Harrington
relationships: son of Lord and Lady Harrington
characters.description: A selfish aristocrat who abandons Juliana for a wealthier match and later tries to destroy her husband.

characters.name: Rupert Ashburn
characters.role_for_strangers: the usurping cousin who stole the dukedom
characters.description: A charming but ruthless nobleman who conspired to have Alexander declared dead and seized the estate.
characters.is_secretly: conspirator in Alexander's ambush and the Dowager Duchess's poisoning

characters.name: Lord Henry Sterling
characters.role_for_strangers: the elder conspirator who orchestrated the duke's downfall
relationships: architect of the false death report
characters.description: A cold, calculating nobleman who manipulates the legal system to legitimize Rupert's claim.
characters.is_secretly: leaked Alexander's position to the enemy

characters.name: Catherine
characters.role_for_strangers: the vindictive noblewoman who poisons the Dowager Duchess and frames Juliana
characters.description: A woman scorned by Alexander's return, she stops at nothing to become duchess, including murder and witchcraft accusations.
characters.is_secretly: poisoned the Dowager Duchess with arsenic

characters.name: Dowager Duchess
characters.role_for_strangers: Alexander's imprisoned mother, poisoned by her enemies
characters.description: The rightful matriarch of Ashburton, slowly poisoned until Juliana's intervention and Alexander's return free her.

characters.name: Lady Ashcroft
characters.description: A status-obsessed woman who disowns Juliana to advance Clarissa's marriage.

characters.name: Lord Ashcroft
characters.description: A weak man who allows his wife to cast out their daughter.

characters.name: Prudence
characters.role_for_strangers: a loyal villager who becomes Juliana's ally
characters.description: A brave young woman who seeks Juliana's help for her brother and later helps her infiltrate the manor.

characters.name: Seamus
characters.role_for_strangers: an elderly villager who respects Juliana
characters.description: A weathered villager who laments Juliana's reduced circumstances but admires her dedication.

characters.name: Father Thomas
characters.role_for_strangers: a corrupt priest who conspires with Catherine
characters.description: A priest who uses his position to manipulate the High Council and delay Juliana's vindication.
characters.is_secretly: conspiring with Catherine to undermine the marriage hearing

characters.name: Agnes
characters.description: A servant who helps Catherine smuggle Father Thomas into the house and witnesses their affair.

characters.name: Vaughn
characters.description: A gruff but loyal retainer ready to eject Catherine on command.

characters.name: Lady Harrington
characters.description: A smug aristocrat who delights in Juliana's humiliation.

characters.name: Lord Harrington
characters.description: A nobleman who sees the Ashburton alliance as a path to greater power.

episodes.summary: Juliana is humiliated at her wedding when her fiancé Gerald marries her sister Clarissa instead, and her family disowns her.
episodes.peak: Gerald declares he chooses Clarissa over Juliana at the altar
episodes.ends_on: Juliana stands alone as the congregation watches

episodes.summary: Juliana confronts Gerald and her family, declaring her dignity intact despite their betrayal, and leaves the chapel with her head high.
episodes.peak: Juliana tells Gerald his word is worthless
episodes.ends_on: Juliana walks out of the chapel alone

episodes.summary: A bearded stranger intervenes when guards drag Juliana away, kneels and proposes marriage, offering her his protection and name.
episodes.peak: The Bearded Stranger proposes to Juliana on one knee
episodes.ends_on: Juliana gazes at the stranger as the congregation gasps

episodes.summary: Juliana accepts the stranger's proposal, they marry in the chapel, and her father disowns her, throwing her mother's ledger into the mud.
episodes.peak: Juliana and the Mysterious Bearded Man are pronounced husband and wife
episodes.ends_on: Juliana and her husband leave the chapel hand in hand

episodes.summary: Juliana and her new husband retrieve the ledger, and he comforts her as they leave her former life behind.
episodes.peak: Alexander kneels to retrieve the muddy ledger for Juliana
episodes.ends_on: They walk away from the church into the rain

episodes.summary: They arrive at his humble cottage in the woods, where Juliana finds peace in the quiet and begins to make it a home.
episodes.peak: Juliana sweeps the floor while Alexander lights a fire
episodes.ends_on: Juliana says she doesn't feel afraid sitting with him

episodes.summary: Gerald and Clarissa visit to mock them, but the husband's silent menace drives them away.
episodes.peak: Alexander appears with firewood and Gerald flees
episodes.ends_on: Juliana and Alexander share a quiet moment after the confrontation

episodes.summary: Juliana learns her husband's name is Alexander and discovers his knowledge of healing herbs, deepening their bond.
episodes.peak: Alexander reveals he knows herbal medicine from soldiering
episodes.ends_on: Juliana realizes she may have found something more valuable than wealth

episodes.summary: Juliana saves a peasant child with herbs, while Gerald reports rumors that Alexander resembles the lost Duke.
episodes.peak: The child's fever breaks under Juliana's care
episodes.ends_on: Blond Nobleman whispers 'Impossible' upon hearing of Alexander's scar

episodes.summary: Alexander is wounded, and Juliana tends him, their intimacy growing as she sees his scars.
episodes.peak: Juliana stitches Alexander's wound and they share a charged moment
episodes.ends_on: Alexander says her touch is the only medicine that eases his pain

episodes.summary: Gerald accuses Alexander of theft, leading to a constable's search that seemingly finds a watch in Alexander's coat.
episodes.peak: The constable finds Gerald's watch in Alexander's coat pocket
episodes.ends_on: Gerald gloats as Juliana looks on in horror

episodes.summary: Juliana defends Alexander, and Clarissa forces her to retrieve a ring from thorny briars to save him from hanging.
episodes.peak: Clarissa demands Juliana crawl through frozen blackthorn for her ring
episodes.ends_on: Juliana turns to the briars with fierce resolution

episodes.summary: Juliana's hands are shredded retrieving the ring, and Alexander breaks free to save her.
episodes.peak: Alexander roars and lunges past the constable as Juliana screams
episodes.ends_on: Juliana finds the ring in the frozen dirt

episodes.summary: Alexander tends Juliana's wounds, vowing vengeance on those who hurt her.
episodes.peak: Alexander bandages Juliana's torn hands and clenches his fist in vengeance
episodes.ends_on: Alexander swears no one will ever hurt her for protecting him again

episodes.summary: Thugs destroy Juliana's herb garden, and Alexander arrives to defend her.
episodes.peak: Alexander storms out of the cottage and places himself between Juliana and the thugs
episodes.ends_on: Alexander stares down the three thugs with lethal intent

episodes.summary: Alexander defeats the thugs, learning Gerald hired them, and comforts Juliana.
episodes.peak: Alexander catches a club mid-swing and throws the thug leader against the wall
episodes.ends_on: Alexander and Juliana gaze at each other as the thugs flee

episodes.summary: Juliana and Alexander share tender moments, strengthening their love and trust.
episodes.peak: Alexander vows no one will hurt Juliana again as long as he draws breath
episodes.ends_on: Juliana rests her head on Alexander's chest, saying she trusts him more each day

episodes.summary: Their cottage burns; Alexander rescues Juliana and the ledger, but they lose their home.
episodes.peak: Alexander tackles Juliana away from a falling beam and leaps through a window with her
episodes.ends_on: Alexander vows they took their home but he won't let them take anything else

episodes.summary: Villagers shelter them; Alexander learns his mother is imprisoned and his cousin Rupert has usurped the dukedom.
episodes.peak: Alexander's informant reveals Rupert and Catherine have imprisoned the Dowager Duchess
episodes.ends_on: Alexander declares the dead Duke is coming home in two days

episodes.summary: Rupert and Catherine plot to marry and execute Juliana; Juliana tends villagers despite her own losses.
episodes.peak: Rupert and Catherine toast their upcoming wedding and Juliana's execution
episodes.ends_on: Juliana refuses to yield to the cold draft, saying she is not finished

episodes.summary: Juliana saves a villager's son, learning the Dowager Duchess is being poisoned.
episodes.peak: Prudence reveals the Duchess is dying of a mysterious wasting illness
episodes.ends_on: Juliana realizes the Duchess is being poisoned with arsenic

episodes.summary: Juliana infiltrates Ashburton Manor as a maid to treat the Duchess.
episodes.peak: Juliana enters the Duchess's chamber and recognizes arsenic symptoms
episodes.ends_on: Juliana whispers 'Someone is poisoning her' as footsteps approach

episodes.summary: Juliana identifies arsenic poisoning and treats the Duchess, but they are discovered.
episodes.peak: Juliana administers charcoal antidote as the door opens
episodes.ends_on: A noblewoman enters and catches Juliana with the remedy

episodes.summary: Catherine whips Juliana and forces her to scrub hearths, but Juliana vows to return.
episodes.peak: Catherine strikes Juliana with a riding crop
episodes.ends_on: Juliana hides her ledger and vows 'I will return. You cannot stop the healer.'

episodes.summary: Juliana tells Alexander about the poisoning; he is furious but supports her return.
episodes.peak: Alexander clenches his fist in rage upon hearing of the poisoning
episodes.ends_on: Alexander walks beside Juliana, demanding she tell him everything

episodes.summary: Juliana continues treating the Duchess, who recognizes Alexander's ring on Juliana's hand.
episodes.peak: The Duchess gasps at the Ashbourne crest on Juliana's ring
episodes.ends_on: The Duchess demands to know where Juliana got the ring

episodes.summary: The Duchess realizes Alexander is alive; Catherine and Rupert arrest Juliana for witchcraft.
episodes.peak: Catherine exposes Juliana as Lady Juliana Ashcroft and seizes her ledger
episodes.ends_on: Juliana is dragged away as Catherine gloats over her mother's book

episodes.summary: Catherine exposes Juliana's noble identity and steals her mother's ledger and locket.
episodes.peak: The Duchess accuses Catherine and Rupert of poisoning her before collapsing
episodes.ends_on: Catherine orders Juliana to the wet cells and claims the ledger as evidence

episodes.summary: Juliana is thrown in a dungeon, defiant that Alexander will come for her.
episodes.peak: Juliana screams she saved the Duchess as the iron door slams
episodes.ends_on: Juliana grips the bars, whispering Alexander's name as wedding bells toll

episodes.summary: Rupert and Sterling plan a show trial for witchcraft to execute Juliana before the wedding.
episodes.peak: Sterling orders Rupert to manufacture evidence and frame the trial
episodes.ends_on: Juliana clutches a rag in her cell as the episode cuts to black

episodes.summary: Catherine burns Juliana's ledger, but Juliana refuses to break, declaring her love for Alexander.
episodes.peak: Catherine holds a branding iron to Juliana's face as the ledger burns
episodes.ends_on: Juliana tells Catherine cruelty doesn't make her powerful

episodes.summary: Juliana's defiance shames Catherine; a maid is coerced into false testimony of witchcraft.
episodes.peak: Juliana declares she was freed by Gerald's rejection and found a man of honor
episodes.ends_on: Catherine raises the branding iron to Juliana's eye

episodes.summary: Lord Sterling forces a maid to lie that Juliana performed witchcraft rituals.
episodes.peak: Sterling threatens the maid's brother to secure false testimony
episodes.ends_on: The maid weeps, apologizing to Juliana as Sterling dismisses her

episodes.summary: Juliana stands trial, refuses to renounce healing, and is sentenced to death.
episodes.peak: The Judge raises his hand in judgment over Juliana
episodes.ends_on: Juliana stands unbroken before the court as the gavel falls

episodes.summary: Alexander's mother escapes the manor and reunites with him, revealing Rupert and Sterling's betrayal.
episodes.peak: Alexander's mother recognizes him and reveals she was told he died
episodes.ends_on: Alexander vows the dead Duke is coming home before the wedding

episodes.summary: Alexander learns the full truth of the ambush and vows to reclaim his title before Juliana's execution.
episodes.peak: Alexander's mother confirms Juliana is to be executed after Rupert's wedding
episodes.ends_on: Alexander stares into the snowy woods, declaring he has two days

episodes.summary: Rupert and Catherine prepare their wedding and Juliana's execution; Juliana remains defiant in her cell.
episodes.peak: Clarissa gloats that Juliana's execution will be a lesson to all women
episodes.ends_on: Juliana curls her fingers in defiance, saying they cannot take who she is

episodes.summary: A kind guard feeds Juliana; she hears wedding bells and prepares to die.
episodes.peak: Juliana hears the cathedral bells and realizes the wedding has begun
episodes.ends_on: Juliana grips the bars, smiling defiantly and whispering Alexander's name

episodes.summary: Alexander's loyalists infiltrate the manor; Alexander cuts his hair and dons ducal attire.
episodes.peak: Alexander shears his hair and declares 'Enough hiding. Today he comes home.'
episodes.ends_on: Alexander marches forward in ducal splendor, vowing to bring his wife home

episodes.summary: Nobles gather for Rupert and Catherine's wedding; Rupert expects total victory.
episodes.peak: Rupert and Catherine exchange triumphant smiles at the altar
episodes.ends_on: The organ chord holds as the ceremony begins

episodes.summary: Catherine halts the wedding to display Juliana as a prisoner; Alexander bursts in, revealing himself as Duke.
episodes.peak: The cathedral doors explode and Alexander strides through the smoke
episodes.ends_on: The royal guards refuse to arrest Alexander, saluting him as Duke

episodes.summary: The Crown Official reads the report proving Rupert and Sterling's treason; they are arrested.
episodes.peak: The Crown Official names Rupert and Sterling as the traitors who leaked Alexander's position
episodes.ends_on: Alexander's mother proclaims him the rightful Duke before the assembly

episodes.summary: Alexander confronts Rupert and Sterling with the evidence; the Dowager Duchess denounces them.
episodes.peak: The Crown Official reads the damning War Office report
episodes.ends_on: Police constables arrest Sterling as Rupert screams

episodes.summary: Sterling and Rupert are arrested; Catherine pleads for Alexander's love but he rejects her.
episodes.peak: Alexander coldly tells Catherine she loved the title, not him
episodes.ends_on: Alexander walks away from Catherine toward Juliana

episodes.summary: Alexander and Juliana reunite; a High Priest declares their marriage invalid due to lack of Crown license.
episodes.peak: Alexander proclaims Juliana his lawful wife and Duchess before the nobility
episodes.ends_on: The High Priest declares their marriage a lie before the Crown

episodes.summary: The High Priest gives them ten days to prove their marriage before the High Council; Alexander accepts.
episodes.peak: Juliana shouts 'God married us! You are just angry no one asked you first!'
episodes.ends_on: Alexander accepts the ten-day wager as the guards lower their weapons

episodes.summary: Catherine schemes with a conspirator; Juliana offers Catherine a position as scullery maid instead of exile.
episodes.peak: Juliana hands Catherine a servant's apron and keys
episodes.ends_on: Catherine accepts the apron, humiliated but alive

episodes.summary: Catherine plots to use Father Thomas to delay the Council; Agnes is tasked with secrecy.
episodes.peak: Catherine tells Agnes ten days is a door that can be closed from the other side
episodes.ends_on: Catherine orders Agnes to bring Father Thomas secretly tonight

episodes.summary: Catherine and Father Thomas conspire to manipulate the hearing and secure her future.
episodes.peak: Catherine and Father Thomas clasp hands in a pact of mutual silence
episodes.ends_on: They agree to keep the hearing unresolved and feed Catherine council secrets

episodes.summary: Agnes discovers Catherine and Father Thomas in bed, exposing their affair.
episodes.peak: Agnes gasps seeing Catherine and the shirtless priest entwined
episodes.ends_on: Agnes stands shocked in the doorway as the lovers lie together

arcs.name: Wedding Humiliation and Marriage to Stranger
arcs.summary: Juliana is jilted at the altar, disowned by her family, and rescued by a bearded stranger who marries her.

arcs.name: Cottage Life and Growing Bond
arcs.summary: Juliana and Alexander build a quiet life in a forest cottage, deepening their love through healing, danger, and a fire that destroys their home.

arcs.name: Infiltration and Poison Discovery
arcs.summary: Juliana enters Ashburton Manor as a maid to save the poisoned Dowager Duchess, enduring abuse from Catherine.

arcs.name: Arrest and Witchcraft Trial
arcs.summary: Juliana is arrested, her identity exposed, and subjected to a rigged witchcraft trial orchestrated by Rupert and Sterling.

arcs.name: Alexander's Return and Revelation
arcs.summary: Alexander's mother escapes, revealing the truth; Alexander returns with loyalists, exposes the conspirators, and reclaims his title.

arcs.name: Marriage Validation Conflict
arcs.summary: The High Priest invalidates their marriage; Alexander and Juliana have ten days to prove its legitimacy before the High Council.

arcs.name: Catherine's Final Schemes
arcs.summary: Catherine conspires with Father Thomas to delay the Council, while Juliana offers her mercy as a scullery maid; their affair is discovered.

title: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke
